paragraphs: Hyman cites Ketubot 100a for the account of Rav Kahana holding beer belonging to Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai, an orphan, etc.

notes.text: The supplied source reads שברא and cites Ketubot 100a. The corresponding paragraph in the consulted edition is at 100b and reads שיכרא, beer. The English supplies beer in brackets; the underlying source discrepancy remains open.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 913) has Ketubot 100a and שכרא, “beer,” where the supplied text reads שברא. The consulted edition places the episode at Ketubot 100b and reads שיכרא. Rav Mesharshiya is the orphan who owns the beer; Rav Kahana is the one holding it. The earlier translation supplied “beer” in brackets.
